sourceSystems.name: Legacy CRM
sourceSystems.purpose: Primary constituent and donor management system.

capabilities.name: Search donors by name
capabilities.businessOutcome: Staff can reliably find the correct donor record.
acceptanceSignals: Search accepts first name, last name, and organization name.
Results show enough identifying information to disambiguate donors.
Opening a result lands on the correct profile.
dataRequirements: Existing donor records with individual and organization names.

capabilities.name: Update donor contact details
capabilities.businessOutcome: Staff can maintain current contact information with auditability.
acceptanceSignals: Email and phone fields can be edited.
Changes are visible in audit or activity history.
dataRequirements: A donor record safe to edit in a test environment.
